title: Union size of low-degree sets
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, and let $S,T$ be subsets of an $n$-element set. If each of $S$ and $T$ has at most $m$ elements, then $|S\cup T|\le 2m$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ belongs to the family of subsets of an $n$-element set of size at most $m$
